comment: Supplies compilerOptions for labkit's .d.ts emission (scripts/build-dts.mts → rollup-plugin-dts). labkit bundles the weasel core + private sub-packages into its dist, so their raw source is compiled here for type emission and must resolve weasel against SOURCE — otherwise types drift to `never`. IMPORTANT: rollup-plugin-dts IGNORES the `paths` below; the build resolves weasel specifiers via the @rollup/plugin-alias table fed by the monorepo's weaselAliases() (scripts/vite-aliases.ts) — the single source of truth, so a package rename (e.g. @orochi235/weasel → @weasel-js/core) is a one-file change there. These `paths` exist only so a direct `tsc -p tsconfig.dts.json` (a diagnostic typecheck) still resolves against source; keep them in sync with weaselAliases on rename, or drop them if the diagnostic isn't needed.
